entries.title: Ashfall
entries.content: A mining city on the flank of a sleeping volcano. Grey ash falls most mornings.

entries.title: The Ash Bell
entries.content: A bronze bell in the old square. By law it is rung only when the mountain stirs.

entries.title: The Ember Guild
entries.content: The smiths' guild. It keeps the city's forges lit and quietly runs the council.

characters.name: Mira
characters.description: Apprentice smith at the Ember Guild, nineteen, good with locks.

relationships.notes: she covers for his late shifts

characters.name: Tomas
characters.description: Mira's older brother, a guard on the night watch.
